text.about: October 31 is a free, cross-platform indie RPG. Create your character, explore dungeons, complete quests, and level up in an ever-evolving world.
text.about_2: The game tells the story of an apocalyptic scenario experienced by the protagonist and has its free classification.
text.about_3: Select one of the classes: Warrior, Wizard, Hunter or Merchant to face the most varied creatures in this world.
text.about_4: Get equipment, evolve your skills, explore the map. All without installing anything, just click and play!
text.contact_description: Contact us if you have any questions, suggestions, or want to report a bug.
text.description_bugs: Check out the list of bugs identified in the game that are already queued for fixing.
text.description_classes: Check the attributes of each class based on the character`s level.
text.description_experience: Check how much experience is required to reach each level in the game.
text.description_items: Select an item from the list to view its details.
text.description_monsters: Select a monster from the list to view its details.
text.hero_description: What was meant to be just a Halloween celebration takes an unexpected turn. Create your character, choose your class, explore the world, face creatures, and uncover the mysteries waiting for you.
text.name: Name
text.suggestion_description: Suggest an improvement for the game and earn a diamond reward for each suggestion approved for implementation. But beware: improvements that have already been identified will not be approved.
text.vote_login_required: You need to log in to vote.
text.wiki_1: Are you curious to know about the game variables?
text.wiki_2: Check the experience tables, learn more about enemies and equipment.
text.wiki_3: Do the calculations and define your strategy!
